question: The headquarters of the Ghadar Movement was located at which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**San Francisco.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ghadar Movement **was a revolutionary movement founded by **Punjabi Indians in 1913 **with the aim of overthrowing British rule in India.
 
• The **headquarters** of the Ghadar Movement was located in **San Francisco, USA**.
 
• **San Francisco** was chosen as the headquarters due to its** large population of Punjabi Indians** and its location as a major port city for international communication and travel.
 
• The Ghadar Movement published a **newspaper** called **Ghadar**, which was printed in several languages and distributed throughout India and other parts of the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **London** was a major center for Indian political activity during the time of the **Ghadar Movement.**
 
• **New York** was also a center for** Indian political activity.**
 
 
• **​**The** five boroughs** that make up New York City are located where the **Hudson River** and the **Atlantic Ocean** converge.
 
 
 
• **Kabul** was the capital city of **Afghanistan**.
 
 
• **22 municipal districts** make up its administrative division.
